pages.text: Pillagers profited from the fall. Outposts, forts, towers, huts and labyrinths hold stolen goods, and the ledgers of the old trade.$(br2)$(bold)Illager Invasion$() adds the ranks: basher, provoker, sorcerer, alchemist, firecaller, necromancer, archivist, inquisitor, marauder, and the $(bold)Invoker$() who commands a fort.

$(bold)Raids$() come from Bad Omen (kill a captain, carry the curse into a town) and from the illagers themselves, who grow bolder as the server does. A village with guards and walls holds; one without does not.$(br2)$(bold)Savage & Ravage$() and $(bold)Respillaged$() make outposts worth the fight: loot, totems, creepers you did not expect.
The Invoker: the fort's master. Summons, shields, teleports, and does not fight alone. Bring recruits. It holds the trading ledgers: the Trading Floor Blueprint.

$(bold)Totems$() (Respillaged) summon captains when you are ready, which is how late Blueprints stay available on a busy server: nobody waits on worldgen for a boss that can be called.$(br2)Pirates (Valkyrien Pirates) hold the sea the way illagers hold the land: ships that fight back, and loot in the hold.
